text:
maya: Quick flag  our Optimize migration guide PR has a couple of small but blocking issues in CI: link-checker found a 404 and snippet-exec failed on an outdated QuantProfile example.

alejandro: Which files?

maya: docs/optimize/migration.md and docs/guide/quantization.md. The snippet still uses QuantProfile(precision=...) and calibrate=True.

sam: New API uses dtype + calibrator class. Fix suggestion:
```python
from redwood.optimize import QuantProfile, DefaultCalibrator
q = QuantProfile(dtype='qint8', calibrator=DefaultCalibrator())
```
sam: Also grep for `kv_cache_enabled`  runtime flag renamed to `kv_prefetch='auto'`.

ci-bot: PR #610  link-checker: 1 broken, snippet-exec: 1 failed. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood.example/610/artifacts

alejandro: I'll open a tiny PR to update the link path (/optkit/quant-profiles -> /optimize/quantization) and swap the snippet. Maya, can you add a migration note about SDK >=0.9 changes?

maya: Yup: short bullet: "SDK <0.9 -> >=0.9: QuantProfile(precision=...) -> QuantProfile(dtype=...) and use calibrator objects instead of calibrate=True."

alejandro: I'll tag @sam for the snippet-test so CI catches this next time.

sam: Will add docs/tests/snippets/quant_profile_smoke.py.

maya: Thanks — if PR lands and CI goes green we'll proceed with the docs sync.
